privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro_body: Midanic ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our software products and services.
privacy.collect_body: We collect information that you provide directly to us, including: name, email address, and contact information; company information and billing details; account credentials and preferences; communications with our support team; and usage data and analytics.
privacy.use_body: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services; process transactions and send related information; send technical notices and support messages; respond to your comments and questions; and protect against fraudulent or illegal activity.
privacy.security_body: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized or unlawful processing, accidental loss, destruction, or damage. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
privacy.rights_body: You have the right to access your personal data; correct inaccurate data; request deletion of your data; object to processing of your data; and export your data.
privacy.contact_body: For questions about this policy, contact privacy@midanic.dz.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.agreement_body: By accessing or using Midanic's software products and services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you disagree with any part of these terms, you may not access our services.
terms.license_body: Subject to your compliance with these Terms, Midanic grants you a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use our software products in accordance with your purchased license type.
terms.types_body: Trial: Limited-time evaluation license with full features. Monthly/Quarterly/Semi-Annual/Yearly: Subscription licenses with automatic renewal. Lifetime: Perpetual license with ongoing updates.
terms.restrictions_body: You may not modify, reverse engineer, or decompile the software; distribute or resell the software without authorization; use the software for illegal purposes; remove or alter any proprietary notices; or exceed the usage limits of your license.
terms.payment_body: All fees are due as specified in your invoice. Subscription licenses will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 7 days before the renewal date. Refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis.
terms.support_body: Active licenses include access to software updates and technical support. Support is provided in English, French, and Arabic during business hours (Algeria timezone).
terms.termination_body: We may terminate or suspend your license immediately if you breach these Terms. Upon termination, you must cease all use of the software and destroy all copies.
terms.liability_body: Midanic shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of our software or services.
terms.contact_body: For questions about these terms, contact legal@midanic.dz.
